## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your preferred solution. Include:
- How it should work
- Any API changes needed
- Configuration options

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases

Provide specific examples of how this feature would be used:

1. Use case 1
2. Use case 2
3. Use case 3

## Implementation Ideas

If you have technical ideas for implementation, share them here:
- Which modules would need changes
- Any new dependencies
- Breaking changes (if any)

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references related to this feature request.
